name: SYNAPSE-4C
description: This current release provides a synthetic temporal Academic Multiplex Network dataset comprising 3,000 researchers and five structured data files: researcher profiles, projects, grants, publications, and researcher interactions. The dataset is designed to represent a realistic academic research ecosystem in which researchers act as common entities across multiple relational contexts. The release encodes multi-layer academic relationships suitable for constructing co-authorship, project collaboration, grant collaboration, and interaction networks.
